name: scope-registry-command-family-filenames
title: Register grill/clusters/scope-extension-decisions filenames in the lifecycle artifact scope registry
description: LATTICE_LIFECYCLE_ARTIFACT_FILENAMES in packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-registry.ts is missing three command-generated story-metadata filenames that packages/main/src/core/store.ts writes to the story dir top level via writeJson: grill.json (store.ts ~line 331), clusters.json (~line 439), and scope-extension-decisions.json (~line 578). Under a mode=enforce scope contract these classify rule=out_of_scope and block phase advancement — the same friction class as the ProofStory artifacts fixed in B-12a1, which deliberately carved these three out as different command families. The registry also lists a singular cluster.json entry that nothing writes (the registry line is the only repo-wide occurrence; active story dirs on disk hold 4 clusters.json and 1 grill.json but zero cluster.json), so it is a stale entry to remove. Extend packages/main/src/tasks/scope-contract-smoke.ts following the B-12a1 proofStoryArtifacts pattern.
